cues.en: Hey, it's Bruno here.
cues.zh: 嗨，我是 Bruno。

cues.en: I'm so impressed with you.
cues.zh: 你的表現讓我印象深刻。

cues.en: You've done so much good work for us that we're going to move you to a big client of ours.
cues.zh: 你替我們完成很多出色的工作，所以現在要把你派去服務一位大客戶。

cues.en: This is our most important client, so we really can't screw this up.
cues.zh: 這是我們最重要的客戶，絕對不能搞砸。

cues.en: Now, this client manufactures construction equipment, and they have some data around bulldozers which they need to run their business.
cues.zh: 客戶製造工程設備，手上有一些業務營運所需的推土機資料。

cues.en: They need to figure out some bulldozer pricing so that they can improve their business.
cues.zh: 他們需要估算推土機價格，改善業務。

cues.en: Now, this client is super important to us, so we need to make sure that this project is top notch and we create a model that they're going to be happy with.
cues.zh: 這位客戶對我們非常重要，所以必須確保專案一流，建立讓他們滿意的模型。

cues.en: And obviously, I thought of you.
cues.zh: 我當然就想到你了。

cues.en: I really believe in you now.
cues.zh: 現在真的很相信你。

cues.en: So we have a deadline tomorrow.
cues.zh: 截止時間是明天。

cues.en: Let's finish it and I can't wait to see it.
cues.zh: 把它完成吧，我迫不及待想看結果。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: There goes Bruno being all demanding and giving us a deadline.
cues.zh: Bruno 又來了，要求一堆，還訂了截止時間。

cues.en: But you know what?
cues.zh: 不過你知道嗎？

cues.en: We have the skills necessary now to deliver on this big project.
cues.zh: 我們現在具備完成這個大專案所需的技能。

cues.en: We're going to predict some bulldozer prices.
cues.zh: 要來預測推土機的價格。

cues.en: That sounds fun, doesn't it?
cues.zh: 聽起來很好玩，對吧？

cues.en: And we're going to learn about something called Time series data, which is very, very common.
cues.zh: 也會學習一種非常常見的資料：時間序列資料。

cues.en: It's going to be another fun one.
cues.zh: 這也會是個有趣的專案。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。
